query: Our React Native 0.81 wallet uses SDK1.0.228. The lending reader fails with a getter-only URL.pathname error. Transaction imports fail without TextDecoder. Explain the runtime setup and keep portfolio reads simple.
expected_behavior: Offer plain HTTP reads when the app does not need the optional SDK reader.
Require standards-compatible URL and URLSearchParams for the SDK reader, plus fetch and cancellation support.
If compatible URL support is missing, install react-native-url-polyfill@2.0.0. Load its auto entry first, before SDK and app imports.
Initialize TextEncoder and TextDecoder before transaction SDK imports. Use the wallet's Stellar SDK and Metro setup.
Distinguish the Babel/Node compatibility check from native device execution. Require target-device transaction lifecycle verification.
machine_checkable: The published SDK reader rejects the stock React Native URL implementation before fetch.
Polyfilling only URLSearchParams still fails reader construction.
The complete URL polyfill preserves cursor=a=b and follows relative pagination after an empty page.
Transaction entry imports fail when either TextEncoder or TextDecoder is absent.
